entries.title: Matthew 24:1
segments: And Jesus went out and departed from the temple. And His disciples came to [Him] to show Him the buildings of the temple.

entries.title: Matthew 24:2
segments: And Jesus said to them, Do you not see all these things? Truly I say to you, There shall not be left here one stone on another that shall not be thrown down.

entries.title: Matthew 24:3
segments: And as He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? And what [shall be] the sign of Your coming, and of the end of the world?

entries.title: Matthew 24:4
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

entries.title: Matthew 24:5
segments: For many will come in My name, saying, I am Christ, and will deceive many.

entries.title: Matthew 24:6
segments: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not troubled, for all [these things] must occur; but the end is not yet.

entries.title: Matthew 24:7
segments: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be famines and pestilences and earthquakes in different places.

entries.title: Matthew 24:8
segments: All these [are] the beginning of sorrows.

entries.title: Matthew 24:9
segments: Then they will deliver you up to be afflicted and will kill you. And you will be hated of all nations for My name's sake.

entries.title: Matthew 24:10
segments: And then many will be offended, and will betray one another, and will hate one another.

entries.title: Matthew 24:11
segments: And many false prophets will rise and deceive many.

entries.title: Matthew 24:12
segments: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many will become cold.

entries.title: Matthew 24:13
segments: But he who endures to [the] end, the same shall be kept safe.

entries.title: Matthew 24:14
segments: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be proclaimed in all the world as a witness to all nations. And then the end shall come.

entries.title: Matthew 24:15
segments: Therefore when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place (whoever reads, let him understand).

entries.title: Matthew 24:16
segments: Then let those in Judea flee into the mountains.

entries.title: Matthew 24:17
segments: Let him on the housetop not come down to take anything out of his house;

entries.title: Matthew 24:18
segments: nor let him in the field turn back to take his clothes.

entries.title: Matthew 24:19
segments: And woe to those who are with child, and to those who give suck in those days!

entries.title: Matthew 24:20
segments: But pray that your flight is not in the winter, nor on the sabbath day;

entries.title: Matthew 24:21
segments: for then shall be great tribulation, such as has not been since [the] beginning of [the] world to this time; no, nor ever shall be.

entries.title: Matthew 24:22
segments: And unless those days should be shortened, no flesh would be saved. But for the elect's sake, those days shall be shortened.

entries.title: Matthew 24:23
segments: Then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here [is] Christ! Or, There! Do not believe it.

entries.title: Matthew 24:24
segments: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and show great signs and wonders; so much so that, if [it were] possible, they would deceive even the elect.

entries.title: Matthew 24:25
segments: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

entries.title: Matthew 24:26
segments: Therefore if they shall say to you, Behold, [He is] in the desert! Do not go out. Behold, [He is] in the secret rooms! Do not believe it.

entries.title: Matthew 24:27
segments: For as the lightning comes out of [the] east and shines even to [the] west, so also will be the coming of the Son of man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:28
segments: For wherever the carcass is, there the eagles will be gathered.

entries.title: Matthew 24:29
segments: And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun shall be darkened and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from the heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

entries.title: Matthew 24:30
segments: And then the sign of the Son of man shall appear in the heavens. And then all the tribes of the earth shall mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of the heaven with power and great glory.

entries.title: Matthew 24:31
segments: And He shall send His angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of [the] heavens to the other.

entries.title: Matthew 24:32
segments: Now learn a parable of the fig tree. When its branch is still tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer [is] near.

entries.title: Matthew 24:33
segments: So you, likewise, when you see all these things, shall know that it is near, [at] the doors.

entries.title: Matthew 24:34
segments: Truly I say to you, This generation shall not pass until all these things are fulfilled.

entries.title: Matthew 24:35
segments: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away.

entries.title: Matthew 24:36
segments: But of that day and hour no one knows, no, not the angels of Heaven, but only My Father.

entries.title: Matthew 24:37
segments: But as the days of Noah [were], so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:38
segments: For as in the days before the flood, they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until [the] day Noah entered into the ark.

entries.title: Matthew 24:39
segments: And they did not know until the flood came and took them all away. So also will be the coming of the Son of man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:40
segments: Then two shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

entries.title: Matthew 24:41
segments: Two shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

entries.title: Matthew 24:42
segments: Therefore watch; for you do not know what hour your Lord comes.

entries.title: Matthew 24:43
segments: But know this, that if the steward of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be dug through.

entries.title: Matthew 24:44
segments: Therefore you also be ready, for in that hour you think not, the Son of man comes.

entries.title: Matthew 24:45
segments: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his Lord has made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season?

entries.title: Matthew 24:46
segments: Blessed [is] that servant whom his lord shall find him doing so when he comes.

entries.title: Matthew 24:47
segments: Truly I say to you that he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

entries.title: Matthew 24:48
segments: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delays his coming,

entries.title: Matthew 24:49
segments: and shall begin to strike [his] fellow servants, and to eat and drink with the drunken,

entries.title: Matthew 24:50
segments: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he does not look for [him], and in an hour which he does not know.

entries.title: Matthew 24:51
segments: And he shall cut him apart and appoint [him] his portion with the hypocrites. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
